entries.title: OpenBCI Ultracortex Mark IV
entries.utility: 3D-printable lattice headwear and adjustable electrode holders offer a concrete mechanical design to study.
entries.limitation: A historical hardware reference, not an approved protective helmet, universal fit, or permission to copy CAD without checking each asset's terms.

entries.title: OpenBCI hardware development
entries.utility: Schematics and board documentation clarify amplifier channels, analog grounding, connectors and existing ecosystem boundaries.
entries.limitation: Board documentation does not establish that a third-party wiring modification is safe for human contact.

entries.title: HackEEG ADS1299 shield
entries.utility: Multi-channel amplifier research design provides an alternative ADS1299 board-level reference.
entries.limitation: The upstream warns of absent patient isolation; it must never be treated as a human-safe wiring template.

entries.title: FreeEEG acquisition project
entries.utility: ADS1299 and ESP32-S3 research prototype illustrates wireless transport and multimodal sensor considerations.
entries.limitation: A prototype with its own safety disclaimers, not a certified acquisition unit or independently established noise specification.

entries.title: PiEEG ecosystem and SDK
entries.utility: PiEEG tools provide Raspberry Pi acquisition, streaming and open software integration ideas.
entries.limitation: PiEEG states its hardware designs are proprietary; an open SDK must not be mislabeled an open-hardware board.

entries.title: BrainFlow biosensor interface
entries.utility: Cross-board acquisition abstraction and synthetic board enable device-free software integration tests.
entries.limitation: Supported boards differ in channel names, rates and clock semantics; API compatibility is not clinical or electrical validation.

entries.title: Lab Streaming Layer
entries.utility: Streams EEG and event markers across processes with clock-synchronization metadata for audit.
entries.limitation: Timestamp correction requires measured drift and hardware trigger verification; no synchronization accuracy is guaranteed by labels.

entries.title: Timeflux real-time biosignal framework
entries.utility: A modular graph runtime for streaming, feedback and reproducible signal-processing experiments.
entries.limitation: A research runtime is not a permission system for collecting human data or activating connected hardware.

entries.title: MNE-Python EEG analysis
entries.utility: Established EEG processing, montage registration and forward/inverse modeling tools help define interoperable scientific outputs.
entries.limitation: Source localization is underdetermined and depends on model assumptions, electrode geometry and independent verification.

entries.title: EEGLAB EEG toolbox
entries.utility: Provides widely used ICA, artifact analysis and electrophysiology workflows for comparative methodology.
entries.limitation: MATLAB and plugin dependencies vary, and processed EEG is not proof of recovered neural sources or reliable intent.

entries.title: MNE-BIDS conversion tools
entries.utility: Connects MNE Python processing with standardized EEG-BIDS data organization and metadata.
entries.limitation: Successful conversion verifies format rules only, not participant consent, acquisition accuracy or sensor safety.

entries.title: Braindecode neural decoding
entries.utility: Contains reusable deep-learning baselines for EEG decoding and reproducible model comparisons.
entries.limitation: Avoid subject/session leakage and claims of universal decoding; a high score can depend on artifacts.

entries.title: pyRiemann signal decoding
entries.utility: Riemannian covariance baselines offer robust low-compute comparisons with more complex EEG networks.
entries.limitation: Statistical decoding effectiveness varies by task, person and recording conditions and is not a validated cognitive classifier.

entries.title: MOABB BCI benchmarking
entries.utility: Cross-session and cross-dataset paradigms model how to avoid cherry-picking classification results.
entries.limitation: Benchmark success is dataset and task specific; models do not validate electrode comfort, hardware safety or unseen real-time use.

entries.title: EEG BIDS interoperability rules
entries.utility: Standard EEG electrode, coordinate system, channels and events metadata provide a portable target.
entries.limitation: BIDS conformance does not prove true electrode positions, de-identification, data sharing rights or scientific conclusions.

entries.title: OpenNeuro research data archive
entries.utility: BIDS dataset publication and snapshots offer reproducibility patterns and discoverable authorized EEG records.
entries.limitation: Each dataset has individual provenance and access requirements; no raw recordings are copied into NeuroShield.

entries.title: OpenViBE visual BCI platform
entries.utility: Visual pipelines for real-time paradigms offer examples of modular BCI orchestration and interaction.
entries.limitation: Copyleft obligations and upstream version compatibility must be reviewed before any distribution or integration.

entries.title: FreeCAD open mechanical CAD
entries.utility: Offline parametric CAD is a credible open alternative for independently editable headform mock-ups.
entries.limitation: Geometric plausibility and export success do not certify wearable safety or protective impact performance.

entries.title: CadQuery Python parametric CAD
entries.utility: Python-first parametric CAD can produce deterministic conceptual components and version-controlled design studies.
entries.limitation: Complex geometry portability depends on CAD kernel and tolerances; add explicit versioned export tests.

entries.title: Zoo KCL CAD design studio
entries.utility: Optional visual and programmable KCL CAD accelerates editable mechanical concept exploration.
entries.limitation: A hosted modeling service is not entirely open source and must not receive private head scans or restricted lab geometry.

entries.title: XERJ research search engine
entries.utility: Optional citation-oriented search over approved committed sources may support agent-assisted research.
entries.limitation: Retrieved passages are not scientific authority; benchmark against local lexical tools and enforce index privacy.

entries.title: NeuroTechX global community
entries.utility: Open neurotechnology community and education networks provide collaborators, reviewers and onboarding examples.
entries.limitation: Community project listing is not a certificate of safety, currency, licensing compatibility or methodological quality.
